name: VMware ESXi / vCenter
description: Shows VMware ESXi hosts and vCenter inventories: every host (connection state, management address) and every virtual machine as a guest of its host, with power state, MAC and IP addresses (from VMware Tools), guest operating system, CPUs and memory. Works with a standalone ESXi and with vCenter through VMware's SOAP web service, read-only: it only reads properties. Use an account with the Read-only role.
author: Netlens
supports: VMware ESXi and vCenter (not tested on real systems)

releases.changelog: Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.
First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
